finding: Original purported exact census used NumPy floating matrix_rank to prune rational rank-deficient cases; independent row-space check also used floating rank. Auxiliary repeated-column test used tolerance-based division and residual checks. Shell manifest/check_logs failures without FAIL output were not propagated.
repair: Bounded integer matrices admit exact modular rank by Hadamard; cleared Gram denominators and direct diagonal structure replace auxiliary tolerances. Shell checks fail closed. Original source archived; all census coverage retained.
scope: No counterexample to the claimed floor found; original numerical decisions alone did not constitute the stated exact verification. Imported mathematical hypotheses remain conditional.
